payload.description:
As a scanner engineer, I want to run plexus evaluate accuracy against the curated gold corpus (not a fixture) so that Plexus stores a real Evaluation with recall.

Feature: Corpus recall evaluation

  Scenario: Evaluate the curated gold corpus
    Given the curated gold annotations loaded as Plexus Items labeled Yes
    And materialized repository scope on disk
    And the detector Score is on the scorecard
    When I run plexus evaluate accuracy for that score
    Then an Evaluation record is stored in local GraphQL
    And the headline metric is recall of detections
    And unread files are omitted from the recall denominator

Out of scope: --baseline, precision, human-accepted labels (corpus is still proposed).
payload.title: Run plexus evaluate accuracy on the curated corpus
